name: review-hidden-decisions
question: 請 review 目前這個未提交的 diff：它應該實作 CHANGE_BRIEF.md 裡核准的「carrier send 2 秒 timeout」。告訴我實際改了什麼、跟核准內容有什麼出入。
boundaries: 退避基準 BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS 從 200ms 被改成 50ms（未核准的行為變更）
最大嘗試次數 MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS 從 3 被改成 2（未核准的行為變更）
CarrierUnavailable 不再被重試——retry 迴圈只接 CarrierTimeout，Unavailable 會逃出 dispatch 且 pipeline 不攔，呼叫端直接吃到未攔例外（重大失敗語意變更）
Receipt 新增 attempts 欄位（未在 brief 中的介面擴充）

probes.question: 核准的變更（timeout）有被正確實作嗎？大意是怎麼做的？
probes.ground_truth: Yes: send runs in a worker thread, join(2s) — no answer within CARRIER_SEND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS raises CarrierTimeout, which follows the retry path. Source: dispatch._send_with_timeout in the diff.

probes.question: 列出這個 diff 裡「未經核准」的行為或介面變更。
probes.ground_truth: Four planted: (1) BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS 200->50ms; (2) MAX_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS 3->2; (3) CarrierUnavailable no longer retried (loop catches only CarrierTimeout; it escapes as an uncaught exception); (4) Receipt gains an attempts field. Pass if >=3 of the 4 named.

probes.question: 改動之後，carrier 回覆 CarrierUnavailable（暫時 5xx）時會發生什麼？跟改動前差在哪？
probes.ground_truth: Before: retried with backoff (RetryableError), worst case dead-lettered cleanly. After: NOT retried — it escapes dispatch (only CarrierTimeout is caught), pipeline.process doesn't catch it (not FatalError/DispatchExhausted) -> uncaught exception to the caller; no receipt, no dead-letter, reservation NOT released.

probes.question: brief 的目標是降低抖動影響。這個 diff 實際上讓「暫時性抖動下的死信率」變好還是變壞？為什麼？
probes.ground_truth: Worse for flaky-but-recoverable carriers: only 2 attempts (was 3) with much shorter 50ms backoff gives transient faults less chance to clear, and CarrierUnavailable now crashes instead of retrying. Trap answer: 'better because timeout was added'.

probes.question: 改動後，全部嘗試失敗前的總退避等待是多少（不含 jitter）？
probes.ground_truth: Only one backoff before attempt 2: 50ms (MAX=2, base 50). Was 200+400=600ms.

probes.question: 這個 diff 有動到 pricing 或稅務邏輯嗎？
probes.ground_truth: No — pricing.py untouched. Correct answer is no / 沒有；說明若捏造 pricing 變更則錯。
